explanations.content: A derivative tells how fast something is changing at a point. It is connected to the slope of a curve, not the area under it.
explanations.story: On a bike ride, your speedometer shows your speed right now. That is like a derivative: the instant rate of change.

explanations.content: In word problems, translate words before calculating. 'At least', 'exactly', 'more than', and 'not' each change the set of outcomes.
explanations.story: Imagine sorting event tickets. 'At least two' means two or more tickets, not only two. The wording decides which tickets go into the answer pile.
